high_level_description: The image depicts a formal event taking place outdoors at what appears to be the Rashtrapati Bhavan, the official residence of the President of India. The setting is a large gathering with numerous individuals standing in rows, all dressed in formal attire, suggesting a significant and official occasion. Leaders from Seven Nations: The text overlay indicates that leaders from seven nations—Nepal, Bangladesh, Maldives, Sri Lanka, Seychelles, Mauritius, and Bhutan—are present.
